content.text: The guard compares the user id to the role list, not the user's role id.

candidates.explanation: The guard checks whether the required role ids include request.user.id (the user's own id) instead of request.user.role.id. The seeded super admin has user id 1, which equals RoleEnum.admin (1), so it passes. Every later admin has a different user id, so the check fails and returns 403.

fix.description: Compare the user's role id against the required roles, not the user id.
